claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer.
claims.evidence: Witness describes an industrial metal gearbox/gear motor housing with a circular front opening, bolts, cooling fins, and mounting base—consistent with a speed reducer/gearbox assembly.
No brand/model markings, labels, or import/Belgium identifiers were reported as visible/readable.
Witness report includes only external appearance; no running/test video, sound, or functional evidence was shown.
No operational footage or internal wear indicators were reported.
No evidence of seals/fastener tampering or internal inspection was reported.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be seized, noisy, or failing under load).
risks.proof: A short video of the unit running under power (show start-up, steady operation, and no abnormal noise/vibration) plus a brief stop/start cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may need repair/overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing/unknown gear ratio and shaft specs (wrong fit for the buyer’s application).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the nameplate/label showing gear ratio, input/output speed, shaft size, and mounting pattern (or a tape-measure shot of shaft diameter and keyway).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown specs (worst-case: buyer may need matching parts).

risks.risk: Potential oil/grease leakage or seal failure not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, seals, and the base area for wetness/residue; plus a wipe-and-check clip after running briefly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible leak/seal wear (worst-case: may require reseal).

risks.risk: Shaft wear/play or damage (can cause vibration or early failure).
risks.proof: A clip showing shaft play check (hands/lever test) and close-up of shaft/keyway condition with measurements.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/unknown shaft condition (worst-case: replacement/repair).

risks.risk: Incomplete kit/accessories (coupling, mounting hardware, motor side parts, or covers missing).
risks.proof: Inventory photo showing all included parts laid out, and a photo of both input and output sides (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing required components).

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or counterfeit/incorrect unit (seller claims Belgium but no identifiers shown).
risks.proof: Readable nameplate photo (brand, model, serial) and any import markings/labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used gearbox with unknown provenance.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the nameplate/label (brand, model, serial, gear ratio, input/output speeds).
Send a short running video showing the unit operating smoothly (no knock) and steady output.
Send close-ups of seals and all joints for any oil/grease leakage (and a wipe-and-check after a brief run).
Send shaft close-ups (keyway condition) and shaft diameter measurement.
Show both input and output sides (motor side/coupling type) and confirm what accessories are included.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an industrial gearbox/speed reducer housing, but the key factors that determine price in Lagos—working proof, exact model/specs, and leakage/seal/shaft condition—are not shown. Without at least a nameplate/spec photo and a running/test clip, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
